title: feat(pm): landing-k, pr-state and sweep-closed-cards --pr replace three retyped landing reads

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgXFRsfSS1tQB1kBxAZ86579)_

Part of #35237
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:产品用户看不到变化;车队席位落地前查"要不要先合主干"、报告前查合并请求的状态、合并后查有没有被误关的卡,这三件事从此各是一条命令。
- 为什么做:这三步过去每次都由席位照着规则文字手工翻日志、数提交、逐张对卡,容易读错基点或漏看误关;交给脚本后规则只算一遍,规则文字一改,脚本自检就会报红。
- 出错会怎样:三个脚本只读不写,出错最多是给席位一个错误的读数,落地前的其它关卡仍然把关;日志过期、读不全或合并后几分钟内,它们明说"答不了",不会给出看似干净的结果。
- 要你做什么:无,席位按审核记录落地。

## What changes

This is slice 2 of the card (landing reads): three readers replace three procedures that the landing and reporting rules spell as prose and that every landing seat retypes. Each prose line now names its reader and keeps its rule sentence.

- **`scripts/pm/landing-k.mjs` (new).** Read-only, `--pr N`. It finds the PR's `pull_request` runs of `ci.yml` (filtered by the PR's own commit shas, because a branch name is reused across PRs: live, `claude/project-thread-w9aa30` carries runs of two PRs), takes the newest completed run whose `Test Core` aggregate is `success`, reads one of its `Test Core (k/N)` shard logs (or the planner's, which prints the same line) and parses `Affected-set diff base: SHA (why)` as PRBASE. **Diff base read from the selector step only:** the line is taken from the job-log section that opens with the `Run bash scripts/ci/select-shard-packages.sh` step header; a log with no such step, no line in it, or more than one distinct base printed is exit 3. K = `git rev-list --count --first-parent PRBASE..origin/main`, after checking that the local `origin/main` is GitHub's `main` and that PRBASE is an ancestor of it. Then the two any-K legs as `landing-operations.md` states them: a new locale pack (a file added under a `translations/` directory after PRBASE whose locale that directory did not hold at PRBASE) under a label PR (the PR file list read against the surface the two translation gates count: translation bundles, `.form.ts` modules, `packages/spec/src`, examples and the packages that own an i18n extract config, from the shared `i18n-bundle-surface.mjs` walk); and the two closed shared-budget books (input or ledger touched both by the PR and by main after PRBASE). Exits: 0 ok, 1 merge main first (each reason named), 2 usage, 3 can't answer. Fail closed: an expired or unreadable log, no green Test Core within the bound, a green run whose shards were all skipped (no line printed), a stale `origin/main`, a PRBASE the clone cannot count from, or a PR file list shorter than the PR's count are each exit 3 with the gap named; an unread PRBASE yields no K and no verdict. A leg that already says merge decides exit 1 and the unread legs are still printed.
- **`scripts/pm/pr-state.mjs` (new).** Read-only, `--pr N[,N…]`, one state line per PR: merged / draft / `mergeable_state` (an open PR's `unknown` is re-read up to `--rereads` times, default 3, 3 s apart; still unknown is INCOMPLETE, never printed as a reading) / queue (membership from the timeline's last `added_to_merge_queue` / `removed_from_merge_queue`; the position from the `gh-readonly-queue` refs, walked parent to tip from the base branch's current tip, read with `git ls-remote`; a queue ref that contradicts the last queue event, with no event or after a removal, is printed and is a gap) / reviews (newest per reviewer: the ones on the head, and apart from them the ones newest on an older commit, each with state and login, because an APPROVED counts on any commit; `--json` carries them as `reviews_at_head` and `reviews_older`) / checks at the head (every page of `filter=latest` check-runs, the count checked, judged with `check-expected-skips.mjs`'s derived roster) / legacy commit status / `auto_merge`, tagged unreliable. Exits: 0 complete, 2 usage, 3 a PR row unreadable, 4 INCOMPLETE (a leg unread, `mergeable_state` still `unknown`, or a queue ref contradicting the timeline).
- **`scripts/pm/sweep-closed-cards.mjs --pr N` (new mode, report-only).** For one merged PR: the closing-keyword targets in its body (the shared `closingKeywordTargets` parser) against the issues the merge closed. Population: the issues the search API lists as closed in `[merged_at − 60 s, merged_at + 600 s]` (count checked) plus every target. A close is tied to this merge when its `closed` event or a `referenced` event carries the merge commit, or when this PR cross-references it, no other PR whose body closes it merged in the window, and the close landed within 60 s of the merge. REST carries no closer field, so this tie is the reading. Live, on PR #35423, the named target closed 4 s after the merge, and a folded card the seat closed by hand closed 112 s after it. A later close is listed as a hand close, with its actor. While the merge is younger than `MERGE_SETTLE_SECONDS` (300 s) the run is UNJUDGED, exit 2, and prints the time to re-run; the clean verdict is never printed inside that window. Exits: 0 every card closed by the merge is a named target · 4 (`EXIT_SILENT_CLOSE`) a silent close, each card named · 2 inside the settle window, an unreadable candidate or a short search · 3 the PR is not merged or unreadable · 1 usage. `--write` and `--all-time` beside `--pr` are refused. The closed-card sweep's own paths, options and exits are unchanged.
- **`package.json`:** `check:pm-expected-skips` now also runs `landing-k.mjs --self-test`, `pr-state.mjs --self-test` and `sweep-closed-cards.mjs --self-test`. No new CI job: the existing "Expected-skips roster self-test" step in the always-on `Lint · repo & tooling gates` lane runs the chain, so all three drift pins (the K block, the per-look and status lines, and the silent-close line) go red on the PR that rewords them.
- **Prose, line counts unchanged, no ratchet ceiling touched** (every touched line ≤ 120 bytes):
  - `landing-operations.md` (112 → 112): the K line keeps K's definition in words and names `landing-k.mjs --pr N` as the reading of K and of the two any-K legs below it. The shared-budget line drops the hand `git diff` spelling and keeps the rule. The silent-close line drops the hand inventory step, keeps the rule sentence and names `sweep-closed-cards.mjs --pr N`. The per-look line keeps "检查与 `mergeable_state`" and "`unknown` 重读" and names `pr-state.mjs`. Kept as written: the PRBASE line, the K ≥ 15 / `behind` / locale line, the two-book line and the label definition.
  - `coordinator.md` (51 → 51): the status line names `pr-state.mjs` and keeps the six facts.

### Fix round 1 (contract review of e9f241b6f5)

- **S1 · `sweep-closed-cards --pr` settle window.** New constant `MERGE_SETTLE_SECONDS = 300` (the 60 s auto-close bound plus four minutes for the search index). Younger merge ⇒ UNJUDGED, exit 2, the line names the re-run time (`re-run at or after …`). A silent close already readable inside the window is still the exit-4 alarm. Cases: `⭐ a merge younger than the settle window is UNJUDGED, exit 2, with the time to re-run — never the clean verdict`, `the window closes at the bound`, `a silent close already readable inside the window is still the alarm, exit 4`, `a merge time that does not parse leaves the window unread`.
- **S2 · the line-77 pin runs where the other two run.** `sweep-closed-cards.mjs --self-test` is in the `check:pm-expected-skips` chain; `check-self-test-wired` passes. The pin's `readFileSync` now sits in a `try` inside the case: a moved or split `landing-operations.md` fails that case with `… could not be read (ENOENT) — moved or split?` instead of throwing outside the harness.
- **S3 · `pr-state` older-commit reviews.** Printed with state and login, apart from the at-head ones, in the line (`newest on an older commit: APPROVED m@dddddddddd (an APPROVED counts on any commit)`) and in `--json` (`reviews_older`). Cases: `⭐ approve, then a merge of main moves the head: the line still says who approved, never only a count`, `--json carries the older reviews apart from the at-head ones`.
- **S4 · `pr-state` queue contradictions are gaps.** Both `queueLeg` branches (no queue event with a ref present; a removal with a ref present) return a gap, so the run is INCOMPLETE, exit 4. One case each.
- **N1 · the silent close has its own exit code**, `EXIT_SILENT_CLOSE = 4`, named in the header, the verdict line and a self-test case that pins it apart from 0, 1, 2 and 3.
- **N2 · battery floor = registered count** for the `--pr` battery (19 = 19); the new and changed batteries in `landing-k` and `pr-state` are pinned at their registered counts too.
- **N7 · line 41** of `landing-operations.md` names `landing-k` as the reading of the any-K legs on lines 43–46 (112 lines before and after, 119 bytes).
- **Diff base read from the selector step only** in `landing-k` (above). Cases: `⭐ the diff base is read from the selector step only: a line another step printed is not read, exit 3`, `⭐ a log that prints two distinct diff bases is exit 3, neither read`, `the same base printed again outside the step still reads, from the selector step`, `⭐ a log with no selector step is exit 3, its line unread`, and the drift pin `⭐ ci.yml's planner and shard steps still open their run block with the selector`.
- N3–N6, N8, N9: accepted as recorded, unchanged.

## Tests

- `node scripts/pm/landing-k.mjs --self-test`: `✓ landing-k self-test: 47 cases pass across 7 batteries — offline, no network.` Batteries are pinned by name with a floor, plus the handshake. They pin: PRBASE from the selector step of the shard log of the last green run on the PR's own commits (a newer green run on the same branch name but another PR's commit is never read; a red Test Core is skipped; the planner is read when no shard ran; a line from another step is not read; two distinct bases are exit 3); K at 14, 15 and 3; a stale `origin/main`, a non-ancestor PRBASE and a missing PRBASE each exit 3; the locale leg (new pack under a label PR merges at K = 3, the same pack under a non-label PR is clear, an already-held locale is no new pack); the budget leg (same book on both sides merges, two different books never meet); every unread leg exit 3. Drift pins: the K block's phrases in `landing-operations.md`, the line `select-shard-packages.sh` echoes, the selector as the first line of the planner's and the shards' `run:` blocks, both ledgers' existence and the three `ci.yml` job names.
- `node scripts/pm/pr-state.mjs --self-test`: `✓ pr-state self-test: 36 cases pass across 6 batteries — offline, no network.` They pin: `unknown` re-read until it settles and bounded, a merged PR never re-read; membership by the last queue event; position by the parent-tip chain; a ref that contradicts the timeline printed, not resolved, and INCOMPLETE; unlisted refs and an unreadable timeline are INCOMPLETE; reviews newest per reviewer at the head and, by state and login, on older commits; checks counted with expected and unexpected skips, every page, a count gap INCOMPLETE; the live roster derived from this checkout. Drift pins on `coordinator.md`, `landing-operations.md` and five `readings-queue.md` phrases.
- `node scripts/pm/sweep-closed-cards.mjs --self-test`: `✓ sweep-closed-cards self-test: 106 cases pass across 10 batteries`. 19 are in the `--pr` battery, pinned at 19 (the battery floor rose 9 → 10). No case of the existing sweep was removed or changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **The settle bound is a choice, not a measurement.** The platform's own close was measured at 4 s; the search index lag was not measured. 300 s is the 60 s auto-close bound plus four minutes; a seat that runs the reader right after a merge gets exit 2 and the re-run time, never a clean line.
- **Two gates caught real slips during this slice, and both were fixed in it.** `check-closing-keyword-parity` flagged a cross-repo closing-keyword regex in `sweep-closed-cards.mjs` as a fourth parser. It was removed, and the mode now reads targets only through the shared parser (other repositories' cards are named as unread). `check:pm-dispatch-gates` flagged a bare `examples/` literal in `landing-k.mjs` as a new escapable-literal row. It is now a pattern (remedy (b): the reader predicates over PR paths and walks no root).
- **The label PR is a surface proxy.** Whether a diff really changes a display label is answered only by running the two translation gates. The reader reads the PR's files against the surface those gates count, and a hit reads as a label PR, so the leg errs toward merging first. The footer says so on every run.
- **A green Test Core with no shard printed no diff base.** That run is exit 3, not a fallback to an older run or to the PR's merge-base: the rule names the last green run's line.
- **Remaining slices of the card** (separate PRs, `Part of`): the round health line; in-flight status and round-open; the deferred `area-lease.md` and `dispatch-runbook.md` pointers; `l1-face`; the os-dev pointers.

<details><summary>Ablations, fix round 1 (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs: the mutation proven on disk, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

Exit 0.` Restored to blob `42474e895358`.
- S2: `LANDING_OPERATIONS_PATH` pointed at a missing file → `1 of 106 case(s) failed`: `✗ ⭐ landing-operations.md still says the rule this mode reads … — … could not be read (ENOENT) — moved or split?`; the harness reports it, nothing throws.

- S3: the older-review text put back to the bare count → `2 of 36 case(s) failed`, including `✗ ⭐ approve, then a merge of main moves the head: the line still says who approved, never only a count — got [0,false], want [0,true]`. Restored to blob `c223d9d860c2`.
- S4, no-event branch: its gap deleted → `✗ ⭐ a ref with no queue event on the timeline contradicts it: INCOMPLETE exit 4 — got [0,true,[]]`.
- S4, removal branch: its gap deleted → `✗ ⭐ a ref after the last event removed the PR contradicts the timeline … INCOMPLETE exit 4 — got [0,true,false], want [4,true,true]`.
- Selector step: the step scope removed (every line read) → `✗ ⭐ the diff base is read from the selector step only: a line another step printed is not read, exit 3 — got [0,{…}]`. Restored to blob `586699eb600f`.

The first S4 attempt used a replacement (` }`) that already occurred 207 times in the file; the tool refused it (`a rise of 0, not the declared 1`), restored the blob and ran nothing. Both legs were re-run as deletions, above.
